ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in Medicaid fraud schemes, including the Feeding Our Future case
questions: How do Medicaid fraud schemes typically operate?
What are the most common ways that fraudsters launder money?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial transactions involved in Medicaid fraud schemes, we may be able to identify patterns and connections between entities that can help us track down and prevent future instances of fraud.
